thread:
Priya: hi @people-ops — quick question. Trying to add my spouse as a dependent but our visa stamping appointment got pushed. do i need the final stamped passport to submit, or can i upload the receipt/i-94 now? i want coverage to start backdated to 4/1 if possible. :pleading_face:

Jordan: hey Priya — thanks for asking. In cases where immigration paperwork is delayed we can accept provisional documentation to start the process, but retroactive coverage is limited by the plan QLE rules. can you remind me the event date and reason (marriage, spouse gained eligibility)?

Priya: married on 2024-03-28 (ceremony in india), planned to add on 4/1. visa stamping got delayed at the consulate, we have the BLS appointment receipt and the I-797 approval + scanned passport copies. stamp expected mid-may. payroll will be different across months so want to understand proration and if any premiums will be deducted retroactively.

Jordan: got it. Two things: 1) Documentation — acceptable provisional docs: marriage certificate + gov receipt showing visa appointment/processing (e.g., BLS/USCIS receipt) + copy of passport. once you get the stamped passport we need the image with stamp. 2) Retro effective date — for a QLE the benefits team can request a retro effective date up to 60 days back from the request date if docs support the event date. since your event was 3/28 and you're requesting now, it's typically allowed to set 4/1 as effective. we'll confirm after docs review.

Alex: tagging in benefits ops. @Alex can you confirm payroll flow? if we approve 4/1 retro coverage today, will payroll auto-deduct the missing premiums or do we issue an adjustment?

Alex: @Priya — for payroll it's usually a retro premium deduction on the next payroll to make the coverage whole. if that creates a hardship we can split the deduction across two pay cycles, but we need to know before payroll cutoff. Also medical carrier requires final stamped passport for dependent eligibility; benefits will proceed provisionally while you provide the final stamp.

Priya: perfect — thanks. how should i upload docs? is there a secure folder or do i email HR? also what's the filename convention so benefits can match quickly?

Jordan: please upload via the People Ops secure portal (link in #people-ops pinned). file naming: `dependent_docs/<your-lastname>_spouse_passport_i94_marriage_<yyyymmdd>.pdf` — e.g. `dependent_docs/Patel_spouse_passport_i94_marriage_20240502.pdf`. if you want to DM the portal link i'll paste it here.

hr-bot: Automated reminder — once you upload, reply here with "uploaded" so benefits can triage. If you need to request a payment plan for retro premiums, fill out the "retro premium adjustment" form in the portal within 3 business days of approval.

Priya: uploaded — i put three files: passport_scan.pdf, i94_receipt.pdf, marriage_cert.pdf (filename per convention). ping me if anything missing.

Alex: seeing the upload, we'll start verification. can you also add your spouse's full legal name and DOB in this thread so we can pre-fill carrier form?

Priya: spouse name is Rohit Kumar Patel, DOB 1993-08-14. thanks all. :pray:

Jordan: thanks. i'll mark this as a QLE request and request retro effective 2024-04-01. benefits will confirm within 2 business days after we get the stamped passport; payroll team will handle the premium proration as discussed. closing loop soon. :white_check_mark:
